title: Notification channel decision ledger
source_scope: Supplied notes N1-N3 concerning selection of exactly one notification channel

entries.statement: Ana, whose title is team lead, said, "I approved SMS."
entries.authority: No authority policy is supplied; team-lead title does not establish approval authority.
entries.classification_basis: N1 reports claimed approval without scope-specific authority.

relations.basis: An SMS template does not establish approval authority, approval time, or implementation status.
Both concern the notification-channel choice; their differing options do not alone establish a conflict.

open_questions.text: Who is authorized to approve the notification channel?
Has SMS been implemented, and is the template production-ready?
Was email merely proposed, or was any later decision made?

coverage_notes: Authority policy, approval time, and implementation status are not supplied.
